releases.description: The supervisor loop itself: planning that reads Initiative Zero, applies reliably and reports failures honestly.

clusters.title: Supervisor apply reliability: session recovery, ship coordination and failed-apply visibility
clusters.description: From Initiative Zero's retrospectives. CIT-450 (do not report success that did not happen) is the first member. Step 1: after a definitive missing-session response (HTTP 404) the workflow's toolbox client reinitializes a bounded number of times, checks completed-operation bookkeeping and idempotency before replaying anything, and has a regression test that loses the session between calls. Step 2: ships are sequenced, so an agent_ship that finds a running job waits or reports instead of failing the batch. Step 3: a failed apply is reported as failed, with its error and the operations that did complete, even when planning continues. Deferred to after step 1: restricting toolbox deploy triggers to relevant source changes.
